No fee figure is published on this track', and filing-instructions.md publishes no figure: 'The held sources establish no filing fee for this petition and this packet states no amount. Ask the clerk.' That is the right answer for Missouri and this factory's own regression test (scripts/grade-a-packet-factory-24h/test-md-pardon-record-disclosures.mjs) names that sentence as true here. WAIVER - absent: MO.memo.json rules.feeWaiver names a waiver route for this track by form number and authority - 'GN10 under Rule 77.03 and section 514.040 where the participant cannot pay and the filing court accepts the statewide form. Not generated by default on this route, because a large share of Article XIV participants have no filing to pay for.' The packet states that route NOWHERE. Measured by exhaustive case-insensitive search across every participant-facing byte this family delivers - participant-instructions.md, filing-instructions.md and the full pdftotext -layout extraction of canonical.pdf: zero occurrences of 'waiver', 'GN10', '514.040', '77.03', 'cannot pay', 'in forma pauperis' or 'indigen'. The record's stated reason bears on whether to GENERATE the form, not on whether to TELL the participant the route exists, and it concedes on its own face that some participants on this route do have a filing to pay for - which is exactly the population a waiver serves. A participant who cannot pay is told only to ask the clerk about an amount, and is never told Missouri has a statewide fee-waiver form or the rule that authorises it.
